svg.title: Why Satori: see every test your AI agent ran
svg.desc: A 14-second loop in two panes. Left, an AI agent terminal: the user asks "add rate limiting to /login and test it"; the agent calls satori run_local with .satori-llm.yml, shows a spinner, then only "8 passed, 0 failed" and "Done. Rate limiting is on /login and all 8 tests pass." A callout asks: Which tests ran? What commands? What did they actually print? Right, the Satori web report #4821 (type Local, repository acme/api, playbook .satori-llm.yml) fills in live as each of the 8 tests lands: lint, format, types, unit tests, two rate-limit tests, semgrep and pip-audit, each with duration and Exit 0. The status turns to Finished and "All 8 tests passed". A cursor opens the test ratelimit > login_429, revealing its command (six curl POSTs to /login), its assertions (assertStdoutContains 429 Pass, assertReturnCode 0 Pass) and its stdout "200 200 200 200 200 429". Caption: and you see every command, assertion and output it ran.

text.tspan: add rate limiting to /login and test it
● I'll add a limiter and verify it with Satori.

svg.text: Your AI agent runs its tests through Satori…
…and you see every command, assertion and output it ran.
